reason: The recorded run corpus is the evidence the engine verdict tests re-check. It is gitignored, so a prune that shrinks it would otherwise turn those tests from PASS into SKIP with no signal. These floors make shrinkage loud: the suite fails while the corpus holds fewer bundles or fewer verdicts than recorded here, or while a protected id is gone. The floor may be lowered only by a documented prune that rewrites this file in the same commit.
